title: Made by the mallet of Los Demiurgos
html_source: Reference to William Blake’s The Book of Los. Los, the creator embodies creative imagination. In Blake’s Milton, a Poem he writes “For every Space larger than a red Glouble of Man’s blood/Is visionary and is created by the Hammer of Los.” Stephen puns (silently) on “visionary” and “visible”: Los created the visible world.

anchor.text: made by the mallet of Los Demiurgos
anchor.prefix: ctably! I am getting on nicely in the dark. My ash sword hangs at my side. Tap with it: they do. My two feet in his boots are at the ends of his legs, nebeneinander. Sounds solid:
anchor.suffix:
. Am I walking into eternity along Sandymount strand? Crush, crack, crick, crick. Wild sea money. Dominie Deasy kens them a'. 

Won't you come to Sandymount, 
Madeline the mare?
